correctness.rationale: The simultaneous induction over arbitrary nested formulas and programs proves three exact parity-sandwich properties. In particular, intersection takes the intersection of parity supports because every operand with a supported parity contains the same diagonal or each atomic edge; composition and star preserve these canonical witnesses. Formula truth depends only on the isolated/nonisolated type, giving four distinct truth pairs via singleton and edge witnesses. A finite independent implementation corroborates 427 bipartite graphs, but infinite correctness is mathematical.
